links.outcome: Ophthalmologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without OphAgent assistance in reader study
links.effect: OphAgent improved diagnostic accuracy by up to 20% across 14 clinically significant tasks; gains stable across regions, experience levels, and languages.
links.quote: In a large-scale global reader study with 311 ophthalmologists from 86 centres across 22 countries, spanning seven languages and settings from tertiary hospitals to resource-limited clinics, OphAgent improved diagnostic accuracy by up to 20% across 14 clinically significant tasks.

links.outcome: Clinician performance when using the AI in workflow versus without, in reader study
links.effect: Ophthalmologists' diagnostic accuracy improved by up to 20% across 14 tasks with OphAgent assistance.
links.quote: In a large-scale global reader study with 311 ophthalmologists from 86 centres across 22 countries, spanning seven languages and settings from tertiary hospitals to resource-limited clinics, OphAgent improved diagnostic accuracy by up to 20% across 14 clinically significant tasks.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent structured inter-agent debate and knowledge base consultation to improve diagnostic reasoning

screen.reason: Evaluates an ophthalmic multi-agent system in benchmarks and a multi-center reader study of 311 ophthalmologists measuring diagnostic accuracy with and without AI assistance.
